boundaries.cost: The named transition cannot use Ash's single-statement atomic path because the locked framework pair cannot translate the custom validation error.
boundaries.bounded_remedy: Keep the explicit non-atomic declaration, PostgreSQL transaction, optimistic lock, and rollback tests together until the framework supports the validation expression or the action is replaced.
boundaries.closure_gate: Before a production state transition depends on this pattern.
boundaries.recheck_trigger: Any Ash or AshPostgres upgrade, or a change to the transition validation.

boundaries.cost: Role graph locking, lifecycle coordination, idempotency, outbox insertion, access resolution, and bounded migration work use explicit SQL that must respect the selected dynamic repository and transaction.
boundaries.bounded_remedy: Keep raw SQL tenant-qualified, route it through AshFoundationLab.Repo, and cover each path with negative tenant, rollback, or concurrency evidence.
boundaries.closure_gate: Before any listed SQL adapter is promoted or reimplemented in the production core.
boundaries.recheck_trigger: A new raw SQL source file, a placement-routing change, or replacement with a reviewed Ash-native expression.

boundaries.cost: AshJsonApi 1.7.1 does not enforce the configured maximum page size at the tested generated endpoint.
boundaries.bounded_remedy: Reject an excessive page limit in the thin edge before generated dispatch and drift-check the documented OpenAPI maximum.
boundaries.closure_gate: Before the production platform exposes a generated public list route.
boundaries.recheck_trigger: Any AshJsonApi upgrade or generated pagination behaviour change.

boundaries.cost: The proposed public transient-error contract needs cache and retry headers outside the generated error body.
boundaries.bounded_remedy: Keep the header adapter allowlisted to the tested status codes and verify the complete response at the transport boundary.
boundaries.closure_gate: Before the production platform exposes the proposed public error contract.
boundaries.recheck_trigger: Any generated error-handler, public taxonomy, or retry-policy change.

boundaries.cost: The checked-in public schema needs a bounded modifier for page limits and transient responses that are not emitted completely by the evaluated generator.
boundaries.bounded_remedy: Keep one explicit modifier, regenerate from the Ash router, and fail the OpenAPI and TypeScript drift checks when output changes.
boundaries.closure_gate: Before a production client is generated from the public API contract.
boundaries.recheck_trigger: Any AshJsonApi, OpenApiSpex, route, page-limit, or public-error change.

boundaries.cost: Generated schema intent does not own mixed-version reads and writes, bounded tenant backfills, lock budgets, constraint validation order, or the irreversible contract gate.
boundaries.bounded_remedy: Keep expand, compatibility, backfill, validation, and contract steps separate and review the four operational artifacts with retained-data tests.
boundaries.closure_gate: Before the first production migration contracts retained tenant data.
boundaries.recheck_trigger: Any retained-data schema evolution, migration generator change, or production deployment strategy decision.

boundaries.cost: The one-way authoring boundary needs a stable-reference allowlist, deterministic descriptor schema, metadata validator, execution registry, and compatibility rules in addition to the Ash model.
boundaries.bounded_remedy: Keep the adapter derived, versioned, code-owned, and limited to approved presentation references; reject model, policy, tenancy, repository, SQL, code, and unknown references before executing the existing authorized Ash action.
boundaries.closure_gate: Before a production descriptor, form/view consumer, report-definition store, or metadata renderer is implemented.
boundaries.recheck_trigger: Any Ash information-API upgrade, descriptor schema change, new metadata kind, new consumer, or stable-reference removal.

boundaries.cost: The disposable proof owns versioned placement transitions, tenant-qualified reconciliation SQL, and trusted target derivation for interface classes that Ash does not route by itself.
boundaries.bounded_remedy: Keep movement transitions named and capability-gated, keep the source authoritative until quiesced reconciliation succeeds, increment the placement version at cutover, reject stale envelopes, and derive every non-HTTP target from the trusted registry before re-entering Ash authorization.
boundaries.closure_gate: Before a production placement registry, tenant-movement control plane, or non-HTTP tenant adapter is implemented.
boundaries.recheck_trigger: Any placement model, movement choreography, routing envelope, non-HTTP adapter, tenant-owned table, or Ash authorization-boundary change.
